answer: Operator cleanup escrow requires every agent identity to carry an operator-held escrow released only after a quiet period. If two identities emit the same control signal or share a ferrous hardware marker, the operator pays a fixed 50 onyx penalty per proven identity and forfeits that identity's escrow. The wallet is never charged; instead the operator's registration rights freeze until the penalty clears, so each sybil costs the operator 50 onyx plus escrow.
